title: This merge will introduce a cherry-picked patch to fix updates containing only the default image, which would otherwise fail to notify snapd.
description:
This merge will introduce a cherry-picked patch to fix updates containing only the default image, which would otherwise fail to notify snapd.

Upstream also improve the unit and CI tests in relation to this bug here: https://github.com/fwupd/fwupd/pull/10092

It was chosen to not include this however, as these tests would likely get skipped due to lack of firmware blobs. This also decreases the delta.

---

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~bamf0/+archive/ubuntu/fwupd-lp2147129-fail-to-notify-snapd
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 53b1f80..3011ff5 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+fwupd (2.1.1-1ubuntu2) resolute; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/p/fix-notify-snapd-default-image.patch: Fix snapd failed to
+    notify bug when only the default image was used. (LP: #2147129)
+
+ -- Simon Johnsson <simon.johnsson@canonical.com>  Tue, 07 Apr 2026 10:14:35 +0200
+
 fwupd (2.1.1-1ubuntu1) resolute; urgency=medium
 
   * New upstream version (LP: #2146332)
diff --git a/debian/patches/fix-notify-snapd-default-image.patch b/debian/patches/fix-notify-snapd-default-image.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..df497ea
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/fix-notify-snapd-default-image.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+From: Maciej Borzecki <maciej.borzecki@canonical.com>
+Subject: plugins/snapd-uefi: fix handling of payloads with default image only
+
+Commit 703e2fd introduced support for firmwares containing more than one 
+update blob, but at the same time it broke handling of firmwares where 
+only the default image is available.
+
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2147129
+---
+Origin: upstream, https://github.com/bboozzoo/fwupd/commit/0b14ba4eceb680e8f5a819e55aabeeda3329b89b.patch
+Bug: https://github.com/fwupd/fwupd/issues/10082
+Forwarded: not-needed
+Reviewed-By: Simon Johnsson <simon.johnsson@canonical.com>
+
+--- fwupd-2.1.1.orig/plugins/snapd-uefi/fu-snapd-uefi-plugin.c
++++ fwupd-2.1.1/plugins/snapd-uefi/fu-snapd-uefi-plugin.c
+@@ -268,7 +268,7 @@ fu_snapd_uefi_plugin_composite_peek_firm
+ 		return TRUE;
+ 
+ 	images = fu_firmware_get_images(firmware);
+-	if (images->len == 1) {
++	if (images->len == 0) {
+ 		/* get default image */
+ 		g_autoptr(GBytes) fw = fu_firmware_get_bytes(firmware, error);
+ 		if (fw == NULL)
diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series
index c58e794..b2df693 100644
--- a/debian/patches/series
+++ b/debian/patches/series
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 flaky-p2p.patch
 fwupdmgr-fde-verify-snapd-recovery-key.patch
+fix-notify-snapd-default-image.patch
